candidates.why_relevant: VERIFIED (README, Cargo.toml, gh API): a GPL-3.0 open-source reimplementation of Yuri's Revenge gamemd.exe written in Rust. It aims to be faithful to the original and reads your own retail MIX files. The renderer is wgpu 27 (the WebGPU API) plus winit, and it runs on Metal on macOS. The README says it is Pre-alpha as of September 2026: a local skirmish on retail maps is playable against a placeholder AI, with retail menus and sidebar. Working: base building, power, tech tree, miners, infantry/vehicle/naval combat, garrisons, transports, Lightning Storm and Iron Curtain, save/load. Not done yet: multiplayer networking, the original AI, campaign, several superweapons and special weapons. It checks its results against the original binary using a 'native oracle' that runs the original code under Unicorn. About 3,824 commits, pushed 2026-09-27, 25 stars. INFERENCE: it is not a web build today, but because it uses wgpu it could plausibly target WebGPU/wasm later. It is also the most faithful fully open-source base, and a strong native Metal path for an HD remaster on the M5 Pro.
candidates.triage_reason: A substantial, actively maintained engine with playable skirmish. It is open source (GPLv3), unlike the proprietary Chrono Divide lineage, and uses a modern GPU API that suits HD rendering work. The main question is how hard web portability would be versus staying native.

candidates.why_relevant: VERIFIED (README, ROADMAP): 'Vanguard Engine', a clean-room GPL-3.0-or-later TypeScript monorepo that runs in the browser. Packages: formats (MIX/SHP/VXL/HVA/TMP/CSF/AUD/INI/MAP decoders ported from XCC and FinalAlert2), a bitwise-deterministic fixed-point sim, rules projection plus a skirmish bot, a Three.js isometric renderer, and a React client. Milestones M0-M9 are done: a playable Soviets-only skirmish against a bot using real rulesmd.ini and aimd.ini, VXL voxel units, shadows, fog, full audio, and a main menu. It also has an 'Original mode' that ships AI-generated and procedural art so it can be played with zero game files. Still missing: Allies, naval, superweapons, Yuri, netplay. 131 non-test TS files (~1.8 MB), 169 commits, last push 2026-07-28, 12 stars, one author. INFERENCE: this is the only fully open, legally clean TS/Three.js base found, and its asset-swap architecture fits an HD/AI-regenerated art pipeline. Its faction coverage is much smaller than Chrono Divide-derived code.
candidates.triage_reason: A near-playable browser engine with a clean license and a modern TS/Three.js stack that is easy to extend for HD rendering. Its limited faction scope is the main risk.

candidates.why_relevant: VERIFIED (README, crate READMEs, tree): an Apache-2.0 'modern rewrite' of RA2/YR/Mental Omega in Rust. It is a workspace of about 20 crates and 820 .rs files: ra-engine (fixed-tick sim with gameplay modules for combat, economy, production, AI, triggers, powers and more), ra-assets (Westwood formats), a wgpu renderer (DX12/Vulkan/Metal), an N-API desktop shell, and a ra-wasm browser binding. The README says ra-wasm is still a placeholder: canvas attach/present exports exist, but the engine and rendering are not wired up for the browser yet. The npm package @game-gpt/red-alert2 named in the README returns 404 on npm (checked 2026-09-27). About 1,661 commits by one author (oovm), 294 stars, created 2026-09-06, last push 2026-09-15; commit timestamps read 2017, which looks odd. No releases. How playable it is could not be verified without building it.
candidates.triage_reason: Large codebase with a modern wgpu and wasm-bound architecture and a permissive license. But its playable state is unproven and the web target is a stub, so it ranks below vera20k. A quick build test would settle it.

candidates.why_relevant: VERIFIED (README, branches): 'Open RTS Engine', which started from ammaarreshi/RedAlert2-Mac-iOS-iPad (the Chrono Divide TypeScript engine) and has grown into its own cross-platform project. It adds a Tauri 2 desktop shell for Windows, macOS and Linux plus the Android and iOS shells, a Mods menu that switches content, and a data-driven Ares compatibility layer in TypeScript aimed at Mental Omega. 306 commits by StillM8 plus 64 inherited from ammaarreshi. The beta branch was active through 2026-09-06. The README mentions releases, but no GitHub Releases are published. The repo declares GPL-3.0, but the engine descends from Chrono Divide code that upstream describes as proprietary and 'used with the author's permission, non-commercial only'. INFERENCE: that is a licensing risk.
candidates.triage_reason: The most advanced independent fork of the known Chrono Divide lineage, with YR/Ares work. Deep-eval it only if the team picks the Chrono Divide-derived path; license provenance must be checked.

candidates.why_relevant: VERIFIED (README): an MIT-licensed browser RTS written 'from scratch in one night' by Claude. It is a pnpm monorepo: pure-TS parsers for MIX/INI/PAL/SHP/TMP/VXL/CSF/maps/audio, a deterministic integer lockstep sim, a PixiJS v8 isometric renderer with palette shaders, a Node WebSocket lobby and relay, and PWA/touch support. It is live at https://peaceful-wave-530.fly.dev. Its gameplay is a simplified RA2-like roster, and it can use your own RA2 files or EA's free Tiberian Sun assets. 20 stars, 109 commits.
candidates.triage_reason: This is an RA2-style game, not a faithful RA2 engine. The MIT-licensed format parsers and PixiJS palette-shader renderer are possibly reusable components.

candidates.why_relevant: VERIFIED (README, tools/fetch-client.mjs): claims to be a 'self-hostable open-source web port' of RA2/YR with offline single-player skirmish and replay. In fact its src/ is the Chrono Divide web client, downloaded from game.chronodivide.com and then split and beautified into SystemJS modules (fetch-client.mjs / split-bundle.mjs), relabeled Apache-2.0. Static GitHub Pages build, created 2026-06-30, 8 stars.
candidates.triage_reason: A repackaged mirror of the proprietary Chrono Divide client, the same lineage as the known repos. Its Apache-2.0 label is legally doubtful.

candidates.why_relevant: VERIFIED (README): 'Rust Alarm', a browser RA2 remake built on 2026-09-04 by Victor Zhou as a one-shot benchmark of 'ChatGPT 6 Astra'. It is a TS/Vite app with a Canvas 2D renderer and an optional 3D renderer that uses authored GLB models. It downloads the RA2 multiplayer installer from Internet Archive, with user consent, and converts the assets locally. Skirmish plus a 'Bootcamp' mode; live at https://ra2.apps.zzn.im/. No license, 6 stars.
candidates.triage_reason: An AI-generated independent RTS, not a faithful engine, and it has no license. Useful mainly as a reference for what ChatGPT 6 produces and for the 2D/3D renderer toggle idea.

candidates.why_relevant: VERIFIED (README, NOTES.md): the OpenRA engine running entirely in the browser as a .NET 8 WebAssembly (Blazor) build, re-hosted from Rosebud's static export (rosebud.ai/play/hv-openra). It uses Emscripten MEMFS, WebGL/GLSL interop and IndexedDB saves, and runs the OpenHV mod. GPL-3.0, 2026-07-03. The related GitLab project https://gitlab.com/openra-wasm-port/root was last active 2024-07-02 and says it is not yet runnable. INFERENCE: this shows the known OpenRA plus RA2-mod route (openra/ra2, or the more complete fork MustaphaTR/Romanovs-Vengeance at https://github.com/MustaphaTR/Romanovs-Vengeance, 343 stars) could in principle be made web-based.
candidates.triage_reason: A lead, not a base. The Rosebud WASM interop source is unclear, and OpenRA's RA2 mod is not faithful to original RA2 mechanics. It only matters if the OpenRA route is reconsidered.

notes:
I found 8 candidates beyond the known list. Only four are worth a deep evaluation: vera20k, Vanguard (harshilmathur/openra2), rust-alert/ra2.exe and StillM8/RedAlert2-Engine. Everything below was checked on 2026-09-27 using the gh API, READMEs and repo trees, the npm registry, the GitLab API and WebFetch.

**Coverage gaps.** The session's WebSearch budget ran out (200/200) and I also hit GitHub search rate limits. Reddit, PPM forums, CnCNet forums and bilibili/zhihu were covered only through the few results already collected, not searched in depth. Gitee returned a redirect and was not searched.

**Other finds, not candidates:**
- **Early or small web engines:**
  - https://github.com/lictl/WebRA2: MIT/GPL, milestone M1 in progress. Only an asset inspector works; no gameplay.
  - https://github.com/ra2ts/ra2ts: small TypeScript prototype from 2023–24.
  - https://github.com/punnerud/mpe-ra: a Rust/wasm game in the style of RA1/OpenRA, not RA2.
  - https://github.com/magicmark/ra2-js: now returns 404.
- **Native C/C++ reimplementations, not web:**
  - https://github.com/SolidFaker/RA2R: C++/SDL3 clean-room rewrite with 1v1 skirmish, MIT.
  - https://github.com/Sovietianqi/OpenYR: C++ reimplementation based on YRpp, GPL.
  - https://github.com/eeyzs1/OpenRA2: C++/raylib with procedurally generated art; not faithful.
  - https://github.com/875341583/RA2_Remake: Godot C#, a single-day code dump.
  - https://github.com/OpenTS-Developers/OpenTS: 543 stars, runs the full Tiberian Sun game, Windows only. It is the sister engine, not RA2.
- **Emulation of the original game:** https://dos.zone/redalert2/ runs the original through js-dos. It is in the same class as the known RA2 VM and ra2-games/ra2 (an x86 VM with an ABI layer, per https://github.com/ruanyf/weekly/issues/11868). Emulation cannot deliver the HD remaster work.
- **Mirrors and forks of the known Chrono Divide lineage, skip:** html-online-game/red-alert2, yunend/ra2, ngapp-net/ra2-client-source, Firfr/red_alert (Docker packaging), MajesteitBart/RedAlert2, airen3339/redalert2, MooZ91/ra2-ipados, dvorovrus/zaiddwiri93-alt/john-overton RedAlert2-Mac-iOS-iPad, OpenRA2/RA2Web (a fork of huangkaoya/ts-redalert2).

**Useful components for an HD/web pipeline:**
- https://github.com/ra2web/ra2web-studio: browser MIX editor covering 16+ formats. It includes a Three.js VXL/HVA viewer and BIK-to-WebM conversion via FFmpeg.wasm. Note that the repo has no license.
- https://github.com/FS-21/Advanced-SHP-Editor: web SHP editor under LGPL-3.0. It has layers and pixel-art resampling (xBR, HQ4x, xBRZ, ScaleFX, OmniScale) and TS/RA2 shadow conversion. Useful for sprite upscaling.
- https://github.com/FS-21/Advanced-TMP-Editor: web editor for TMP terrain tiles, including Z-data.
- https://github.com/Hansimov/ra2-explorer: browser asset explorer under MIT, with online version https://hansimov.github.io/ra2-explorer.
- https://github.com/zhaishuaigan/ra2-map-editor: online map editor under Apache-2.0.
- https://github.com/Heli-Lab/relert.js-browser: JavaScript map-scripting interface.
- https://github.com/CnCNet/WorldAlteringEditor: C# map editor.

**Inferences and risks:**
- vera20k and Vanguard are the only fully open-licensed bases that are faithful or near-faithful and at least partly playable.
- Every Chrono Divide-derived codebase carries licensing risk from upstream's "proprietary, used with permission, non-commercial" terms, including the known repos, StillM8 and openyrweb.
- For a "2026-level" HD remaster on the M5 Pro, a wgpu-based Rust engine (vera20k or ra2.exe) gives native Metal and a possible WebGPU route. A TS/Three.js base (Vanguard or the Chrono Divide lineage) stays browser-first.
